overall_summary: Most videos have low sample sizes under 300 views, but Husband-Wife relationship dynamics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,679 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,666 views) are clear outliers showing massive relative success. General family relationship topics perform moderately, while deep sad shayari drastically underperforms.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life struggles ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') generated 1,600+ views, significantly outperforming family or pure shayari shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife emotional realities, unspoken compromises, and post-marriage relationship shifts.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video titled 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' only managed 6 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract, or overly bitter literary poetry; ground the emotion in concrete everyday scenarios.

next_video.hook_style: Direct question about daily married life friction
next_video.concept: A couple sitting in complete silence in the car or living room, both busy on their phones, realizing how text chats used to go on for hours while in-person conversations have completely faded.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound of tapping phone screens and a soft sigh in a quiet room.
next_video.twist_direction: The realization that they live in the same room, but their real home is now inside their separate screens.
next_video.posting_window: 13:00 - 14:00 (matching the high-performing husband-wife upload time slot)
next_video.reason: Capitalizes on the proven high-engagement husband-wife relationship niche while testing a relatable modern communication fatigue angle.

experiment: Testing if modern digital detachment within marriage drives higher retention than romantic nostalgia.
